## TASK
最后一次有限修正build_prompt中指尖尺度矛盾：宏观明显分离与近距离接触不可见分开，禁止追逐单图标准答案。
## FILES
只 First_Phase/scene_demo/finish_v1/vision.py 内所给第二条指尖观察字符串。
禁止改动：第一条指尖定位字符串、其他提示文本/函数/labels/images/decide/reconcile/标定2mm/控制/Git。不发Qwen或物理。
## STEPS
1. 只JSON {"edits":[{"path":"First_Phase/scene_demo/finish_v1/vision.py","old":"所给第二字符串完整原行","new":"同缩进的一条完整替换字符串行"}]}。唯一edit，不给全文/测试/解释/围栏。
2. 新字符串明确：当完整hand silhouette包括手指在相互印证的视图中明显远离target与support，且target由destination独立支撑时，宏观可见分离允许released/clear_of_target True，即使更细的pad边缘无法分辨；不要求微小接触缝或历史释放运动。
3. 仅近距离、投影重叠、包裹bottle neck/rim时需观察真正fingertip-to-target和fingertip-to-support gaps；可见接触为False，间隙遮挡且无其他视图消歧为null。完整指尖识别保留，不得用只圈腕壳的错误bbox证明退离；开放encoder alone仍不能证明release。
4. For place, operation_achieved means placement plus support only, independently of released and clear_of_target。用直接图像证据，不用固定像素坐标/场景位置/任何样例标准答案，不把bbox规则硬强制True，不改变任何布尔判据。
5. 只写英文通用说明字符串，旧第一字符串与所有其他字节保留。程序单测由worker机械增加现有case断言，不生成测试。
## INTERFACE
build_prompt(context)->str、_vision schema、decide/reconcile/standard_open_finger_qpos/2mm hardgate不变；完整原字符串如下。修改的是自然语言尺度说明，不是新的完成条件。
## DONE WHEN
end_turn完整唯一old/new，AST仅第二字符串内容有变化；原真实图/标签/坐标/控制不变。Qwen0/物理0；候选由GPT验收，不无限迭代。
## REPORT
只返回JSON edits，old逐字唯一匹配所给原行，new保留原行缩进和合法Python字符串语法。

UNCHANGED FIRST STRING
Gripper includes both fingers, dark finger pads and fingertips, not merely the white wrist housing or forearm. Localize the complete hand including its lowest protruding tips. Wrist-view fingers may be visible only partly at image edges; dark pads must not be mistaken for the table or background.
ONLY REPLACE THIS ACTUAL LINE
        "Before released/clear_of_target=true, inspect fingertip-to-target AND fingertip-to-support gaps in each useful view. Visible touch or wrap around a bottle neck/rim means false; if the fingertip gap is occluded or tips cannot be identified and no other view resolves it, use null, not an assertion that fingers are retracted. Do not infer lack of contact solely from the main object's body being clear.",
